visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Crown Du stands on a wooden porch, wearing a white fuzzy sweater. She holds a steaming bowl of instant noodles. The background shows a rustic wooden house and grey winter sky. She speaks with animated facial expressions, eyes widening and mouth moving quickly. (2) A close-up shows a bundle of yellow wavy noodles being lifted out of the soup by wooden chopsticks. Steam rises. Text overlays in blue and white characters appear over the center of the frame as she demonstrates the food. (3) She carries the bowl to a heavy wooden outdoor table. She bends over to place it carefully. The environment looks cold, with dry grass and leafless trees visible in the distance under a flat grey light. (4) She picks up several wooden logs from a stack and places them around and over the bowl. She adjusts the chopsticks so they are wedged between the logs, holding the noodles suspended in the air. She points at the camera with a playful smile. (5) A brief shot of a small body of water nearby shows a layer of ice covering the surface. The shore is covered in brown, withered vegetation and some light frost is visible on the fence. (6) Back to the creator on the porch. She speaks directly to the camera, looking expectant and energetic. The background shows the wooden railings and a glimpse of the snowy Austrian landscape. (7) The next morning, Crown Du is in a beige coat and a yellow Minion-themed beanie. Soft white snowflakes are falling around her. She points to the snowy trees and yard, looking surprised and shivering slightly. (8) She checks the noodle bowl. The noodles are still held up by the chopsticks, now stiff and frozen in place. She pokes at them with her finger. Yellow variety text and animated exclamation marks appear on screen. (9) She lifts the noodles, which are stuck in a frozen block. The soup underneath is still dark and liquid. She brings the bowl close to her face, peering at the texture with a confused expression. (10) Inside a kitchen at night, she wears grey and white striped pajamas. She stands in front of a stove, holding the bowl. The lighting is warm and indoor. She talks about frying the frozen noodles to salvage them. (11) Close-up of a grey non-stick frying pan. The bundle of noodles is placed in the pan. As it heats, she uses a spatula to try and flip them, but they stick significantly to the surface and tear apart. (12) She sits at a table, eating the fried noodles from the bowl. Her face contorts in a grimace of disappointment. She continues eating but talks about how bad the texture is. A red 'FAIL' graphic and an angry emoji appear on her forehead as she finishes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Female speaker begins with a fast-paced, high-arousal tone in Traditional Chinese. A cheerful acoustic guitar and light percussion BGM at ~110 BPM provides a poppy rhythm. The mix is studio-clean with no significant ambient floor. (2) The voice maintains a friendly, animated tone. A bubble-pop SFX emphasizes the appearing text overlays. The BGM continues its upbeat major-key melody with constant acoustic strumming. (3) Subtle rustling of clothes as the speaker moves and points. Voice pitch variably climbs as she explains the setup. The music remains the primary audio layer beneath the continuous speech. (4) Distinct percussive thuds and clattering sounds of wood logs being stacked. The speaker's voice is slightly muffled as she moves away from the microphone. BGM beat remains steady and optimistic. (5) Ambient environment floor shifts to a low-frequency outdoor hum. The speaker's voice tone becomes questioning and intrigued. A high-pitched 'ding' bell SFX signals a rapid scene change. (6) Voice arousal peaks with a loud, high-pitched question. The music beat hits a short pause then resumes instantly. No other environmental noises are present in this short segment. (7) Drastic shift in ambient floor to a cold outdoor space with audible wind bursts. The speaker lets out a sharp 'Oh!' reacting to the snow. Voice quality is slightly breathy and strained. (8) Sharp metallic/tapping sound as the speaker pokes the frozen noodles. A cartoon 'booing' or 'boing' SFX plays. Her voice is high-pitched and full of excitement. (9) Slurping sound as she tastes the frozen noodle block. The BGM volume ducks slightly under the vocal delivery. A comedic 'fail' buzzer SFX plays as she describes the result. (10) Audio environment shifts to indoor kitchen room tone. Voice becomes calmer and narrative. Music switches to a slightly slower, comical acoustic track with piano accents. (11) High-intensity sizzling sound as the noodles hit the hot pan. The speaker's voice becomes projected to be heard over the cooking noise. (12) Grating metallic scraping sounds as the spatula hits the pan. Percussive 'impact' SFX emphasizes the sticky noodles. The BGM maintains a jaunty, ironic tone. (13) Loud slurping and chewing sounds. The speaker's tone shifts to exaggerated disappointment and playful anger. Laughter track SFX and a final comedic 'stinger' music cue end the track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Challenge Setup -> Overnight Time-lapse -> Failure Reveal -> Attempted Salvage -> Final Disappointment
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator attempts a popular internet challenge involving frozen noodles in Austria's freezing weather. After the experiment results in a partial failure, she tries to cook the frozen block, which leads to a funny and unsatisfying outcome, providing humor and a lesson on food experimentation.
